title: The fibre shares the flowers’ honour
literal_meaning: Through the flowers’ touch, the banana fibre is delivered.
meaning_odia: ଫୁଲ ସହ ରହି କଦଳୀପଟୁକା ମଧ୍ୟ ଆଦରର ସ୍ଥାନ ପାଏ। ସେହିପରି ଭଲ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସଙ୍ଗ ଜଣକୁ ଉନ୍ନତି ଓ ସମ୍ମାନର ସୁଯୋଗ ଦେଇପାରେ।
explanation: The fibre gains a place of honour because it is joined to flowers. The inspected gloss uses this image for the benefit someone receives through good company or a valued association. Here “delivered” carries the figurative sense of being raised to a better position.
usage_example: A beginner joins a thoughtful group of craftspeople, learns from them and gains opportunities through their shared work. Someone recalls the saying about the value of good company. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ପଟ here is the banana-plant fibre used with flowers, rather than finished cloth. In the flower-and-fibre image, something ordinarily overlooked shares the flowers’ honoured place because the two are joined.
